issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO technical correction for R5 asking to update the BiologicallyDerivedProduct.productCode ValueSet so ISBT-128-labeled products are represented with ISBT 128 product codes and the sample expansion includes the listed product-code examples.
initial_application: The BDP terminology source was created by 7df03635aab94c2496e85ab54566c9e8ae52e0d3 with eight sample concepts and a ValueSet compose that includes the BDP product-code CodeSystem. The Jira-linked FHIR-37977 implementation commit 917d5b573d6b9617aaf67e5beccbf996698f7cdb updated the CodeSystem description and added the missing T1396 concept. Related FHIR-38028, already represented on the combined branch, updated the ValueSet description to the current ISBT 128 Product Description Codes wording.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/biologicallyderivedproduct is current build scope. Later BDP terminology work is separate: FHIR-49688 has already been audited on the combined branch for metadata cleanup; FHIR-49979 and FHIR-53477 are still Resolved - change required follow-ons about moving ISBT code systems/fragments to THO/external URLs and code casing; FHIR-55000 is Triaged.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source keeps the productCode binding to ValueSet/biologicallyderived-productcodes, the ValueSet includes the BDP product-code CodeSystem, and that CodeSystem contains the nine sample concepts from the issue family. Changing the CodeSystem URL, content mode, or code casing here would prematurely implement later terminology migration work rather than reconciling FHIR-37977.
